results.text: Comparison of the effects of losartan potassium and benazepril in the treatment of hypertensive patients with insulin resistance. To compare the efficacy of losartan potassium (LP) and benazepril in the treatment of hypertensive patients with insulin resistance (IR). This is a retrospective analysis of the clinical data of 155 hypertensive patients with IR admitted to Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Hospital from March 2021 to March 2023.
